reviews.title: a very disappointing experience
reviews.text: two hours delay in departure. No explanation or apologies given. Poor cabin service, unfriendly in flight service. Poorly dressed and sloppy looking crew.
reviews.author: DCtraveller41

reviews.title: bad experience with JetBlue
reviews.text: I am completely disappointed with this company, get out of them, everything happened to go and come back, total lack of respect for customers, I bought my flight precisely for the arrival time at my destination in Punta Cana which would be 10:30 am, this way I could make better use of my vacation days, however, my flight was scheduled to leave Boston at 6:35 am on 01/09/2023 and arrive in Punta Cana at 10:30 am, but JetBlue only said it was late, we waited a long time, until we boarded, we spent almost an hour on the plane before we got off again and waited a long time for another boarding, at the end of it all I only arrived at my destination, it was already past 6 pm, I lost an entire day of my vacation, day of my return which was 08/09/2023 from Punta Cana to Boston with a stop in Ny and arrival in Boston, such was my surprise when I arrived in Ny the flight that was to leave for Boston at 10:50 pm was cancelled, the staff giving vague answers, they said that our flight to Boston would only leave the next day at the same time, that if we wanted we would have to wait more than 24 hours and that JetBlue would not pay for the hotel, I saw many people indignant, without answers, with much insistence they put me on a flight at 3 am, to get to Boston, when I arrived in Boston my suitcase didn't come, after a lot of searching for information they said they would deliver it to my house, 2 days later, avoid this company, because if you have problems they are totally uneducated to solve problems, I hope I never have to fly with JetBlue
reviews.author: cecilia correia

reviews.title: great airlines
reviews.text: jetblue did really an amazing job finding my luggage ,agent Tricci from MCO airport was super helpful.thank you again for delivering it to my house.
reviews.author: ADAM86

reviews.title: First time on jetBlue Airways. Very impressed indeed, especially with free WI-Fi. Highly recommended.
reviews.text: First time on jetBlue. As a non-legacy carrier I expected this to be cramped and very basic indeed. How wrong I was! Seats were comfortable with generous legroom. Aircraft interior looked new although the aircraft was an older A.320. Cabin service with free nibbles and soft drinks handed out by excellent, helpful znd gfriendly cabil crew. The high spot thpough was the end to end FREE Wi-Fi throughout the flight. Never had this in Economy on any other airline. Well done jetlue for leading the way with what, in this day and age, should be a standard offering. I cannot recommend more high;ly.
reviews.author: Michael L

reviews.title: Just bad airline. Always chaos
reviews.text: Used to be great airline to fly with. They got to big. Last few trips always delays. Caos in the airport. Dirty old plans. Poor customer service. I rather fly with the big name such as delta and AA which improve significantly. So sad
reviews.author: Avikorine1

reviews.title: Extremely Unprofessional Airline
reviews.text: What should have happened: 1. Depart at 4:27pm ET 2. Arrival at 11:17pm ET (8:17pm PT) For a total duration of 6h50. What actually happened: 1. On tarmac at 4:27pm ET 2. Told at ~5:30pm ET that our initial tarmac lane got closed due to wind conditions and air traffic control is working on getting us another route 3. Told at 6pm that we got a new route but that the plane needs more fuel for the elongated route, so we need to go back to the gate 4. 6:30pm we are back at the gate for refueling and sit there for 15min. 5. 6:45pm we are on our way to the tarmac again 6. 7:00pm our new route is closed due to wind conditions, we're waiting for new re-routing 7. 8:15pm we are given a new route but the plane doesn't have enough fuel for that route 8. 9:30pm we are back at the gate and are told to deplane and JetBlue is attempting to find a new crew as the initial crew will not be part of the flight anymore due to some legal reason. 9. 9:45pm our flight is cancelled So after 5h+, for a 6h50 flight, we are back to square one. What did we get? a 12 dollar voucher to spend on dinner. As a reminder, that gets you 2 chocolate bars in the overpriced Terminal 5 at JFK. In addition, the commentary of the crew was absurd. The pilot mentioned "we need about 2000 extra gallons of fuel for this new route" but wouldn't tell us what the time estimate of that is. What kind of metric is that, do we all have a PhD in aviation? Extremely disappointed in this airline, will try to avoid at all cost. I'm going to cancel my flight since this airline isn't even offering a flight for the next day so far (3h post cancellation and their representative at the gate said we'd be scheduled within 1 to 2 hours). They get a 1/5 from me.
reviews.author: Hamza L

reviews.title: No help when they cancel flight
reviews.text: Cancelled flight yesterday with no options to rebook. Called what I thought was their cancellation line and person on phone represented themself as jet blue rep. Was told no jet blue flights for four days so was charged 1064$ to switch flight to delta. Thought it seemed pricey so waited 1.5 hours to be told by nasty jet blue agent that they could do nothing because the jet blue agent I talked to requested refund. I also paid 230$ for hotel last night. Jet blue said it is not their fault flight cancelled and they don’t know who I talked to on phone who said they were jet blue rep. So I am currently sitting in Newark airport hoping to get to Orlando via Cincinnati today. If your flight cancelled, jet blue does nothing but send you on flight days later and you have to pay for meals and hotels. I fly alot and have had flights cancelled but never had no flight rebooked within 24 hours and hotel voucher. End of a great vacation ruined. Never again. Delta has been much more helpful but I am no home yet so story continues.
reviews.author: Barbara E

reviews.title: Zero customer service
reviews.text: Got to airport at 8 am for flight on a Sunday morning. The board said cancelled. Not a soul to help at customer service. On a Sunday in the summer?????? I had to book a flight on Delta to get home. I then spent 3 hours waiting on the Chat line customer service to chat with a representative. I was able to get a full refund for my ticket but…… I no longer want to fly this airline. It’s not the first time it left me hanging with a cancelled flight. One time I booked them and next thing I know is that I am on an American Eagle flight. They used to be the best, not anymore.
reviews.author: Kim C

reviews.title: DON’T FLY JET BLUE!!!
reviews.text: We booked with Jet Blue years ago and they randomly cancelled our flight. Luckily we got notice and were able to book with Delta. I thought it was no big deal at that time now fast forward to yesterday.. We were supposed to fly out of Charleston to Fort Lauderdale and take a flight from Fort Lauderdale to Salt Lake City. Our flight was delayed 5 times. We finally boarded the plane after 3 hours of waiting. The air conditioning was not working. They said we would be in flight soon. Next thing we know we are told we have to get off the plane. Then the flight is delayed again. There was no way we were getting to Salt Lake City. Our 3:00 flight left at 8:00. We didn’t go to Fort Lauderdale. Instead we were offered a flight the next day to Boston and then to Salt Lake City. We had no car and no hotel. We had to demand a hotel voucher. I was ready to turn into a true Karen. Now we are still in Charleston and 4 of us have to miss work tomorrow due to this chaos. We planned our trip specifically so we’d have one day before work. If I could give them a zero star I would. There were so many other people on that flight that had places to be and the delay reason kept changing over and over again. I would not recommend them at all.
reviews.author: Allerz16

reviews.title: Horrible decline in service
reviews.text: There was a time JetBlue was a premium airline but definitely no longer the case. Two flights with them in the past week, both delayed several hours, unfriendly staff and broken down aircrafts. Never flying JetBlue again
reviews.author: Notnown

reviews.title: Appalling service - never again
reviews.text: Absolutely appalling service from cabin crew and ground staff. Where are all the jovial pre-Covid staff who made flying on jet blue enjoyable. It is now a mass market budget airline with no empathy for delayed passengers whatsoever. Ready to board JFK and stopped due to maintenance issue. Then co pilot departed due to alleged illness and we waited hours for a new co pilot. By the time we departed it was runway chaos at JFK where we sat for another hour. Four hours without a beverage offered in spite of Jet Blue being popular with senior citizens and the disabled. Asked flight attendant a simple questions and received a surly response. Who are these new people and from which cesspool were they recruited? Paid 84 for an aisle seat so could call for crew assistance with hand luggage due to an injury, and had to rely on passengers for assistance. Never again. This is not a Covid issue it's poor management. Jet Blue code shares with American Airlines with whom I'm a platinum member and I would never received such poor service from American Airlines.A recession is coming and they will be singing a different tune very soon. Shame on you Jet Blue and RIP.
reviews.author: NY-LON-PB
reviews.route: New York City - West Palm Beach

reviews.title: Delayed
reviews.text: How can we have a flight on time when all the jet blue staff strolled in later than the passengers. They were laughing and chatting fir 40 mins before taking guests to check in.
reviews.author: Christina R

reviews.title: The worst travel experience I've ever had.
reviews.text: On 6/16, my husband and I were flyinh out of Cancun at 12PM. We received notification that the flight was delayed, but the email SAID they were working to resolve it and to come on time anyway. We spend over 12 hours as our flight kept getting delayed. I attempted to contact customer service but received no update. In fact, the customer service was very rude. At the very last minute, our flight was canceled with NO information. We were booked on the next flight out the following day. One problem is that I was hosting a baby shower for my best friend on 6/17. JetBlue gave NO opportunity to rebook the flight KNOWING it was going to be canceled, nor did they allow us to reschedule through a different airline. I've cried several times over this JetBlue put us up in a motel in Cancun that was not even 1% compared to where we were. Sketchy and no security. They also gave us a 4-plate buffet of stale food at 11 PM. AWFUL On 6/17, we received an apology email admitting they screwed up- An "avoidable cancellation." JetBlue offered a $100 credit to each of us. $100?! We don't get out time back, let alone enough credit to take another flight! I wrote a long email to JetBlue execs and the response that I received was "Too bad, you only get $100." I have never in my life had such a WORSE travel experience nor received the most awful response from customer service. JetBlue is the worst airline out there. Never again will we fly with this company.
reviews.author: Stephanie Y.

reviews.title: Worst Experience Ever
reviews.text: The worst airline ever. Our flight was delayed for more than four hours without any valid reason on our way to Lima, Peru. The flight attendant was incredibly rude and my return plane was canceled supposedly because of weather conditions while the other airlines had no issues. I would never fly with them again. Horrible experience!
reviews.author: Lorena V

reviews.title: Customer Beware-Jetblue Refund Policy is Terrible
reviews.text: Jetblue has so many restrictions on its airfare refunds it is not worth the trouble booking with them. On January 11th, the day all airlines were grounded due to aviation system issues, I had a flight to Florida. Delta graciously refunded my money when I decided not to fly after waiting 6 hours at the airport. Delta even offered me a flight later in the week at no extra charge. On the other hand, Jetblue refused to refund my return fare (within a week) because the aviation system issue did not occur on the day of my return flight. However, I would receive a credit. I just tried to use our Jetblue credits on a Carribbean flight and they were rejected. Jetblue's policy is that a domestic credit could only be applied towards a domestic flight. I can't transfer the credits to a family member either. It's just another unfair business practice to keep customers' money caused by an issue out of the customers' control. Our refunds will probably expire before we go on another vacation. I recommend that everyone buy travelers insurance because you can't rely on JetBlue to do the right thing by its customers. Better yet, fly another airline.
reviews.author: lc332016

reviews.title: Women
reviews.text: Very unprofessional and disrespectful. Accused child exploring a minor because I asked the center seat if he liked his hand device game switch and the flight attendant accused me child exploration. As a 55 mother of 3 grown adult children it was unexplainable and discrimination!!! Never will fly JetBlue again!
reviews.author: Kim

reviews.title: Has gone Downhill
reviews.text: I have probably flown with Jetblue 50 times and I used to go out of my way to choose them over United. I started to notice the quality that used to set Jetblue apart was lacking about 2 or 3 years ago. It got to the point where I really did not care if I flew United or Jetblue (and United started to improve recently). Now, however, I will be looking at United first and only flying JetBlue if I have to. The staff have become rude, the flights less reliable, the amenities in the aircraft themselves have vanished, and customer service simply does not exist.
reviews.author: DougD72

reviews.title: Worst Airline to book with No helpful managers
reviews.text: Booked tickets through the JetBlue site directly not a 3rd party, only to have the money deducted from my PayPal but not ticketed. Called in to be put on hold for over an hour and the price went up 4 times what I paid. We then have been told we can rebook at $579/ticket for tickets that we paid and have a receipt for $134 to book an hour earlier and their site had an error leading to the issue. After several transfers still no resolution but they have taken payment but we have no tickets. Terrible customer service, even when offered proof of payment we were told we'd have to dispute the payment and book at the $579 per ticket.
reviews.author: David H

reviews.title: JetBlue is horrible...NEVER again.
reviews.text: I was at the gate waiting to board the plane and it was delayed with no communication. I expressed concern because I had a connecting flight and did not want to miss the second plane. They reassured me that I would get their on time. The flight was then delayed an additional two hours, fifteen minutes before the new time was supposed to leave with no communication. It was sunny outside and not raining. I immediately requested that they put me on another flight with another airline company and was put on the last flight at 10 pm. The customer service rep told me to go to terminal A (it was terminal B), and I had to find my way to the shuttle from terminal C. I had been there since 2 pm for the 4 pm flight, and ended up leaving at 11 pm on American airlines due to the rain.
reviews.author: Sonia G

reviews.title: Dont fly jetblue unless you enjoy being raked over coals
reviews.text: 2 days before my trip, I went on the website to double check arrival times and gate numbers, and I noticed my seats have been reassigned through a pop up notification. well, turns out "reassigned" means taken away and you need to pick new ones. Well I never got notified or sent any formal message telling me to change seats. Here I am 2 days before my trip, traveling with an infant, not guaranteed a seat on a flight I payed 2k for unless I pay an extra 900 bucks for upgraded seats. When I called to sort this out I was told, I would be guarantted a seat on the plane, but it would be through standbye. When I asked what stand bye was, I was told it was based on availability of seats and not promises....what?!?!?! SO now I am forced to pay an extra 900 bucks or risk not traveling to my vacation. Thanks Jetblue.....
reviews.author: Randy A

reviews.title: Jetblue terrible
reviews.text: In this June 2023, more than twice my kids lost their flight for a non reason delay. When you call them they dont give you any reason. Customer service even ashame cause they dont know what to say.
reviews.author: David L

reviews.title: Poor quality
reviews.text: Entertainment screens not working on one side of aeroplane, pilot promised a $15 voucher for those affected but never received. Return flight one week later most of entertainment screens not working, no broken promises this time as nothing offered! On both flights drinks and snacks were poor quality and staff adequate.
reviews.author: Les C

reviews.title: Terrible service
reviews.text: I love jetblue. But the flight attendant from this day wow. They all had atitude and can’t comunicate! If you are not happy with your job dnt work there ! We are paying to have a good time and good service. Jet blue should chose better their employees! Really disappointed!!
reviews.author: Aline C

reviews.title: Flew once never again.
reviews.text: Singled out and double charged for carry-ons for specific seats and passengers only. I found it quite odd to be singled out and forced to check in our carry-ons with an added penalty of double the check-in fee. I politely tried to work with them at the gate knowing the plane was not full while watching others board near us with carry-ons that were not charged. Enough empty overhead bins and empty seats on the flight that the passengers that witnessed it and were not charged actually told us how wrong it was for them to do that. I politely offered to pay extra to bring our carry-ons onto the flight instead of checking them in unnecessarily. They wanted $300 to upgrade our seats for the privilege of a carry-on. Feel a bit taken advantage of and the customer service number is a joke.
reviews.author: Colin T

reviews.title: Where are my bags
reviews.text: I arrived at the airport 3 hours before take off but a problem with my ESTA at check in meant I had to apply on the spot for a new one. It was agreed that if the ESTA did not come through before check in deadline I could be placed on the next flight. The original flight had a 10 minute delay on the board when the ESTA came through, the ESTA arrived and I was at the check in desk 55 minutes before original take off time. Check in always takes time, but the supervisor agreed that we, and our bags, would make the flight. Arrived at Fort Lauderdale, no bags. Went to the “ bag service desk” and was initially dealt with by a woman who didn’t seem to know what she was doing, then with help she located our bags, still at Cancun, they had missed our flight and the following flight 2 hours later. Because our onward travel was by car to Bonita Springs she said I would have to return the next morning to collect our bags as they would not deliver that far, despite the document I was given saying they would deliver. ABSOLUTELY NO HELP FROM THIS WOMAN. We eventually booked a hotel, on our own, and paid for it. Arrived back the next day, same woman, same level of help. After 4 hours wait I went to see a supervisor who assured me our bags were there but waiting for customs clearance and they could not hurry them. Terrible terrible service, from this service desk operative. Got the bags 28 hours after we landed. Now, JetBlue do not answer their telephones, we found that when the hotel were trying to contact them for us. The only way to contact them to discuss a claim for the hotel bill is by telephone, and we are in the UK. A phone bill for attempts to contact them would probably exceed the hotel bill, so we gave up. Then received an email giving me a $60 credit on an account I can only use to buy tickets within the next 6 months. We are not travelling to the US in the next 6 months!! Oh, the flight was really nice, we had paid for upgraded seats and the crew were very caring ( unlike the baggage claim staff) Not an airline I will choose to fly with again,
reviews.author: Nick G

reviews.title: Nightmare
reviews.text: Don’t fly JetBlue! What a nightmare! We were stuck on an airplane for 9 hours from Tampa to JFK. We had a connection flight to Rochester and we missed that too. The airplane had to refuel twice at the Newark airport. We were stuck in gates and taxing around. We boarded that airplane at 12:45 and didn’t get off it till 9pm. The communication was awful from JetBlue. They should have canceled the flight from Tampa to jfk. No other available flights to Rochester till 8am when we landed. With 2 kids and they didn’t even have food available for purchase on the airplane. They didn’t want to issue a refund to my credit card 💳 they wanted to give me a travel credit. As if I would ever book jetblue again. It took multiple contact with different crew members and when they couldnt help they just dead the conversation and say sorry for the inconvenience have a nice day. I rented us a car and we ended up driving from nyc to Rochester overnight and made it home at 6am. Here is the icing, they issued each ticket holder a 50 dollar credit for the inconveniences but refuse to put all the credit in one account to be use for convenience under one reservation whenever we see fit. 200 credits that will be going to waste. I’m only seeing back 665 dollars versus the 804 dollars because they still want to charge for a flight they should have cancel due to safety concerns. I wrote them a nice feedback email 📧 and I’ll be posting this on their page too for everyone to see because I can be petty too
reviews.author: Yenny H

reviews.title: Will be flying on other carriers from now on
reviews.text: After a grueling day getting off a cruise ship and waiting hours to pass through Immigration and Customs, my daughter and I learned that our flight was delayed...not once or twice but several times. Their excuse was inclement weather in the northeast but as it turns out (as I happened to overhear from two airport staff guys later that day), flight crews had refused to work our flight back to NY. Two hours after we were originally supposed to depart, they canceled our flight with no real explanation. I scrambled to rebook another flight home and our only option was a flight on American to NJ instead of NY. I booked it though the app, ended up paying for our seats, and though we finally made it back, my grief wasn't over. I have been trying to claim miles/points for that flight for us since and repeatedly that request was denied! Jetblue LIES about how to get your miles/points. You can request them all you want but you'll never get them. I'm going to stop flying JetBlue. I'll fly with a carrier that actually cares about their customers. Save yourself the aggravation and do the same.
reviews.author: S.B.S.S.

reviews.title: Delayed flight and bags missing
reviews.text: We were due to fly out at 12:55pm, my sister checked if our flight was on time and she discovered it was delayed 3 hours. We didn’t receive any updates or text about the change. We went to the gate and we were changed on the next flight 1 hour later. The air hostess ensured me it bags were changed to our new flight. When we got on the play it was dirty and very old. When we landed we discovered we have no bags! The information staff for JetBlue were very unhelpful. We were promised our bags would arrive later but they didn’t. We have been left with nothing. Why promise something and not deliver
reviews.author: Clo

reviews.title: INOPERABLE MINT SEATS
reviews.text: We cashed in 220000 points to fly MINT back to LA from east coast. I had not flown Mint since before the pandemic. As soon as the 5+ hour flight took off it became clear that I had a hugely malfunctioning 'lie-flat' seat. As I pushed the button to recline the head rest feel completely off, leaving a hard swath of exposed metal as a 'cushion'. Next the seat completely jammed up and wouldn't moved up or down -- it was stuck in a weird, very uncomfortable position -- half up/ half down. The poor flight attendant reported that the seat was supposed to have been fixed the day before but apparently hadn't been. He attempted to fix the seat which then rendered my partner's 'life flat' seat inoperable. When trying to deal with customer service today (after waiting 45 minutes on hold) we were told that it is their 'no exceptions' policy to only offer a $100 credit if a seat malfunctions. Needless to say we will not be flying Jet Blue ever again. What an insanely disappointing experience.
reviews.author: ELF

reviews.title: Highly Recommend. Staff are great!
reviews.text: Highly recommend travelling with Jet Blue. The staff couldn’t be more helpful. We had an issue with our flight. The times were changed and we didn’t know. They put us on a flight the next day with no hassle and no extra expense. It was a stressful time and they handled it with grace and speed.
reviews.author: Eileen W

reviews.title: They Have Done Nothing and are all out Ideas
reviews.text: I should probably wait a bit to write this considering I’m still waiting for them to get me and my two kids home. We boarded the plane and began to taxi toward our runway on time and things were looking pretty good. Once we were in line for take off we experienced a short weather delay which caused our pilots to “go over” their allowed hours. The following then occurred: 1) We returned to the gate where no one had any clue if we were offloading or staying on. Eventually we were instructed to offload. 2) Once we were back in the terminal the staff placated us over and over insisting the flight would just be delayed and they were finding a new pilot. 3) We watched as our baggage was offloaded while the staff inside insisted that meant nothing. I think the term I’m looking for is we were getting gaslit. 4) After hours of insisting the new pilot was on the way, the staff finally announced the flight was canceled and our bags could be picked up and the baggage claim. They also insisted that despite their current disarray, someone downstairs had a plan, a flight and some kind of help. 5) Upon arrival downstairs the three already busy staff members had no clue why we were there not what the plan was. We waited for hours while those staff helped absolutely zero passengers (I am not kidding not being hyperbolic, for almost two hours they had the same people in front of them and helped none of them). At least once during the wait a staff member took a moment out of their busy…..whatever it was they were doing… to yell at us… yes to yell at the customers waiting for help. 6) The end result was no help, a promise of a new flight the next day and nothing along the lines of any apology. Never again, no way, no how.
reviews.author: Jason

reviews.title: TERRIBLE RESERVATION PROCESS
reviews.text: AVOID BOOKING ON JETBLUE. I booked a ticket and JUST TRIED TO CHANGE IT TO THE NEXT DAY. The whole process is SO COMPLICATED. You are NOT ALLOWED TO DIRECTLY CHANGE THE RESERVATION. You need to CANCEL FIRST, THEN RE-BOOK. You are not allowed to cancel the reservation yourself. You need to go through an agent, which takes hours to reach. Okay, now you've got the refunds. You need to book a new reservation. Then it raises an error "Travel Bank is unavailable. Travel Bank funds may not be combined with Points." So all the points and refunds you've got from cancelling the reservation cannot be used!!!! Now, if the new ticket has higher prices, you need to use a credit card, Jetblue DOES NOT ALLOW you to use points, refunds, and credit card together. If you ask an agent to book the new reservation for you, you need to pay $25 SERVICE FEE PER PERSON. RIDICULOUS PROCESS. Jetblue designed it system ON PURPOSE to make you pay for each step you make.
reviews.author: Remy K.

reviews.title: HORRIBLE FLIGHT ATTENDANTS
reviews.text: I have never been treated so disrespectfully by a group of people in my entire life. I had the misfortune of experiencing Dawn the flight attendant on a flight from Orlando to Boston on May 29th 2023 departing at 7:00am. I am a young professional and frequent flyer of Jet Blue... until now. On my flight from Boston to Orlando I requested to purchase a Bud light during the beverage service portion of the flight. Not that, this is the business of a SERVICE PROVIDER, but, I had the day off and wanted one drink to sleep since my travels flipped my schedule around. Dawn, the oldest flight attendant said "Im gonna need your ID" while SMIRKING, TWICE, in a veryyyy dramatic and rude tone. She made it clear that she was annoyed by my purchase. THEN she held it up to the light in front of the everyone else on the plane?? I am 23 years old. I know I look young. IDing me is not an issue, but this was mortifying, Im disgusted. She failed to scan the ID, which is a much more professiona (and effective)l way of verifying an ID. She then laughed out loud and said "I didnt think Id be selling alcohol this early" in the rudest tone possible, and her crew laughed with her. I studied abroad, I travel for work, I have been on a ton of flights. I have never ever been treated in such a disrespectful manner by a service worker. Or flight attendant. As she walked away I said thank you and she didn't say your welcome. Despicable, disgusting behavior. I will remember this for the rest of my life and I am seriously reconsidering using Jet Blue ever again!!!!! Upon exiting the crew I thanked the entire cabin crew and no one said your welcome. Retrain your staff!!!! I've worked in customer service facing role and I've never seen such jarringly disgusting behavior form anyone. It costs nothing to be kind.
reviews.author: Kerri D

reviews.title: Worst Airlines
reviews.text: Worst airlines ever! Canceled my flight to Ft. Lauderdale in the morning before departure because the aircraft maintenance issue. Airline agent at the gate rolled their eyes when you ask for help. I have to booked myself one way flight with southwest on that day. They delayed my going home flight for 2 hours due crew issue. I waited 1hours to speak with customer agent on the phone...
reviews.author: Quan

reviews.title: Jet Blue DO BETTER PLEASE
reviews.text: Either you Pay your workers more money to represent your brand. Re train then in actual in person customer service. Or THROW THE WHOLE AIRLINE AWAY. Everyone is mean and has problems and takes it out on the simple question asking customers. Your workers are mean they didn’t give proper flight information to customers neither on time. Yiur treated as of your in a correctional facility trying to receive assistance
reviews.author: Dream Q

reviews.title: 4.0 rating perhaps a decade ago
reviews.text: Horrible, two times in one year one cancellation & two multi-hour delays with gorgeous weather. I’m avoiding this airline like the plague & will happily pay up.
reviews.author: Climb To G

reviews.title: Worst transatlantic experience to date
reviews.text: AWFUL international. Gave no dinner on a 7.5 hour flight. Also, no vegan choice for the light meal. Domestic connection missed out some of us with drinks service. Headphones that barely work and don’t fit. Don’t have the tv episodes like other airlines. AWFUL customer service also. Now on return flight and have no vegan food choice (and wouldn’t let me book it online). For 1980’s Afghanistan, passable service; for 2023 transatlantic, very very poor- NOT CLOSE TO VIRGIN OR BA. Worse than United/ American/ Northwest.
reviews.author: Mr M

reviews.title: Ms.
reviews.text: Very bad customer service, will never fly with JetBlue again, very dissatisfied and not enough leg room.
reviews.author: Vanessa P

reviews.title: Bad experience
reviews.text: My husband and I traveled with our two young kids. We checked in a stroller in perfect condition. When we arrived in New Orleans, the stroller was broken. I was very upset since we do not have a stroller at the beginning of our trip and we don’t have a place to put our 1 year old while we explore New Orleans. We filed a complaint with JetBlue baggage claim. They asked for invoice, pictures, report, license, proof of address, proof delivery and etc. we sent all the information which included the stroller invoice purchased last year. After reviewing our claim, they did not refund the full amount that we paid for the stroller that they broke. As a result, the difference has to come out of our own pocket. No sympathy for all the inconvenience and hardship they caused us. When I asked to speak to a manager, it was non existence. Three days later, I was sent an email in a PDF format stating that all managers are too busy to get on the phone and that that unfortunately, due to the fact that the stroller was a year old, they cannot compensate for the full amount. This is absolutely disappointing. We did not cause the damage. While our stroller is a year old, we handed it to JetBlue in good working condition. They gave it back broken and refuse to pay for a new stroller. Due to inflation, stroller actually cost more now and we never got compensated for the time and hardship they put us through because of their carelessness and lack of customer service. I will absolutely avoid this airline moving forward.
reviews.author: ladyoftruth1

reviews.title: Save your money
reviews.text: Book with Jetblue. On the return trip at 10:45am. Our flight was delayed hour by hour, until finally the employees got off the plane. Flight was not canceled for another hour after they left. Told us that was booked on another airline. Got to the counter to check-in. Our order was not processed right. We miss the flight. We are still at the airport at 7:30 pm. No flight and no hotel. Pay the money and fly with another airline.
reviews.author: Phil

reviews.title: Jetblue will steal your money
reviews.text: I never even got to fly to my destination, Jetblue robbed me of over $1000 and are trying to shift the blame on me. I booked a honeymoon flight for my wife and I back in 2021, which we could not take because of covid restrictions. We were issued travel credits (that expire for no apparent reason) instead of a refund. Now we had to scramble to find the time and money to take a vacation within their expiry period during a global pandemic. We tried to book a flight for a shorter vacation, but the schedule would not work out for us so we would have to postpone by canceling that next flight. They gave us a hard time for even doing that like we were trying to find some loophole to buy more time (but why do these even expire?). Then we could finally cancel it and receive MOST of our credit back and they sent an email saying the credit will be valid until it expires (1 year per their policy), but they did not list the date on the email. I tried to go back and book a summer vacation using point I knew I had and saw those points expired THE DAY AFTER THE REFUND. I called to ask them to reinstall that credit since there was no warning and customer service hung up on me. I called back and someone at the escalation department was saying it was my fault for not being responsible with the credit! The gall on these people trying to gaslight and steal from me! Then when I asked how could this corporation have the heart to do this to someone who saved their hard earned money for their honeymoon that was shafted by the pandemic, they hung up on me again. Jetblue is making my blood boil! I tried citing them to the BBB but they sent some pre-generated response about the BBB not having jurisdiction over them because of the Airline Deregulation Act. This is the singlemost crooked corporation I've ever had the displeasure of TRYING to patronize and I hope anyone who sees this never makes my mistake and finds an alternative airline.
reviews.author: Dante

reviews.title: Awful service! Scam service
reviews.text: Customer service ( from desk agents) just not trained and represent great service Bought ticket and paid additional $65 for the bag! Had another option ( I was told) take another flight Bought speed access and still was told to stay in the regular line Delta so much better
reviews.author: Yanina T

reviews.title: Horrible experience from beginning to end
reviews.text: It was a horrible experience from beginning to end. Our flight to Denver was delayed for over an hour and our flight back to New York was delayed, delayed, delayed and then after 4 hrs in the airport, cancelled. What was really infuriating was that the initial reason that the Jetblue spokesperson gave was that they were having staffing issues, but when they cancelled the flight, they said it was a weather issue; therefore they didn't need to reimburse anyone for anything. What a lie! The kicker was that the earliest next flight out was 2 days later!!! OMG!
reviews.author: Mommyhua

reviews.title: So disappointed
reviews.text: I am so disappointed in Jet Blue. I received an email today that the flight I booked last month had changed. The reservation had us flying on a connection during our other flight. We were told that we could not be accommodated and needed to cancel our flight. As our accommodation and vehicle are already booked, we are now scrambling to find flights. We will never fly Jet Blue again.
reviews.author: Terry

reviews.title: Inconsistent at best
reviews.text: Did a round trip here...outbound, the attendants were surly but efficient. Flight arrived on time. Inbound flight attendants very friendly, landed on time but a long time to get to gate and off the plane... missing my ground connection.
reviews.author: robert b

reviews.title: Twice in a month JetBlue delayed my flights for hours.
reviews.text: I used to love JetBlue. Times have changed. Once flying with them was a pleasure. The customer service was a huge part of it. As of today, I’m cutting up my JetBlue credit card and plan to use another airline. Twice in the past month my flights have been hours and hours of delays. Today my 6 am flight was postponed causing me to miss my connection. They said we would board at 7:30 am. After 8:00 and no announcements many of my fellow passengers went to customer services for help. They had one person at the help desk. Honestly, I felt sorry for her. I got on another flight but now my luggage will not arrive until tomorrow. JetBlue you are in need of some serious training in customer service. Your lack of caring speaks volumes and shows throughout your entire experience.
reviews.author: Msarrt B

reviews.title: Exceptional service on flight B61754 (SJU-FLL) Thank you Eddie, Judy, Chason, and Kayla!
reviews.text: Flight B6 1754 on 5/1/23: My wife and I want to thank the JB crew on this flight: Eddie, Judy, Chason, and Kayla. My wife and I were traveling back from SJU (work for me; pleasure for her) and they took exceptional care of us! I am a frequent flyer with JB and couldn't be more thankful. Again, thank you, flight crew, B6 1754 from SJU to FLL 5/1/23!
reviews.author: FLO

reviews.title: Delayed by 4 hrs twice in a month
reviews.text: Not sure what’s wrong with JetBlue, if it’s staffing, too many flights, not enough planes, whatever! Two flights delayed 4 hrs!!!! Unacceptable, both tickets should be at least 50% reimbursed. Got $25 voucher only for one flight. Both incidents involved LAX and NYC flights.
reviews.author: Danielle M

reviews.title: Beware of promises for compensation due to delayed flight….
reviews.text: Flight 378 was scheduled to depart from Vegas at 2 pm, March 6th. We boarded the plane at 5 pm and experienced further delays until the pilot announced at 7 pm that the flight would not take off that evening and instructed us to disembark, proceed to the ticket counter and work with an agent to get another flight booked. ( note during the two hours on the plane, there was no air conditioning, the cabin temperature was uncomfortably hot and we were only offered a few ounces of water one time). Having already been at the airport for 8 hours and not wanting to stand in line with the hundreds of other customers to get rescheduled, we went online and rebooked two of the few remaining seats on the March 7th Jet Blue 378 flight and concluded we would follow up once home, to square away compensation for our additional expenses. We took a taxi back to our hotel, checked back in, had dinner, breakfast the next morning and returned to the airport. Thankfully we departed without incident and arrived home on the 7th, a day later than originally scheduled. I contacted Jet Blue customer service to initiate reimbursement for our expenses ( including out of pocket costs for the new flight) on March 12th. That day, I was able to secure credit for the additional tickets and was told to submit a claim online for the incidental expenses ( mentioned above), including receipts which I did. In total, I requested $861.25 to cover hotel, taxi to and from airport, dinner on the 6th, breakfast on the 7th and an additional day of parking expenses in Boston. I received an email on March 23rd from Jet Blue Customer Support (Ajinkya) that indicated reimbursement was approved for $306, covering only a portion of our hotel expenses ( maximum $250) and the taxi to and from the airport. No compensation was provided for any meals or parking. I immediately emailed back indicating I was not satisfied with this reimbursement and received a second email from Ajinkya on March 31st saying that this amount was the “maximum permitted” even though on your website it claims that compensation for an onboard delay on departure of over six hours is due $250 per ticket. Yesterday, I spent additional time on the phone with customer service supervisors Stephanie and Karen who reiterated this position, although Karen did offer me additional $75 pp courtesy credits for future travel. Karen indicated the compensation matrix is based on the fact we rebooked onto a different Jet Blue flight instead of on the delayed flight. I challenged her that this seemed to be semantics, but she did not alter her position. Jet Blues Contract of Carriage document provided to me, on page 58, bullet item #12 states “ If a passengers travel is disrupted due to Controllable irregularity and the passenger experiences a departure delay of six (6) of more hours , carrier May, upon request from the passenger, provide the following amenities: meal vouchers and/or a hotel voucher.” This is the reason I conclude Jet blue has inadequately compensated me for the significant delay in my flight described above. I hope you can appreciate my frustration after a 24 hour delay in my return to Boston and now several hours trying to claim legitimate expenses incurred because Jet Blue was unable to fulfill the commitment it made when I purchased my original tickets. I have also submitted a written complaint to Jet Blues CEO and as of this date, have not received a response.
reviews.author: Lynne H

reviews.title: Don’t Do It
reviews.text: Stay far away from this company!!! They are Horrible. My flight was canceled with no communication and no one at the desk in the airport. I had to purchase a new ticket for a same day flight ($$) Called and request a refund and was told I’m not getting one and my money has been forfeited. I was also told that if I disputed with my bank I would be on the block list and could never fly with JetBlue again….. for a flight they cancelled with no notice!! Please go elsewhere. My experience was today May 19, 2023
